content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Alex, if your lower back hurts after deadlifts, don't push through it. ⚠️ Drop the load a lot, or pause deadlifts, until you can train pain-free. Check that your setup is sound too: keep your back neutral, keep the bar close, and don't grind out ugly reps. If the pain is sharp, gets worse, lasts more than a few days, or comes with numbness or tingling, stop and see a doctor or physio. 💪
